Title: Users may experience delays completing mailbox offboarding because the migration task is blocked and cannot finish

User impact: Users may experience delays completing mailbox offboarding because the migration task is blocked and cannot finish.

Current status: We've identified that the mailbox migration task is being delayed due to the integrity validation process remained pending at the completion stage. We're disabling the integrity check for the affected mailboxes to remediate impact. We're monitoring the migration to confirm successful completion and validate that offboarding can proceed as expected.

Scope of impact: Impact is specific to some users in Asia Pacific region attempting to completing mailbox offboarding.

Root cause: The mailbox migration task is being delayed due to the integrity validation process remained pending at the completion stage, resulting in impact.

Next update by: Thursday, August 20, 2026, at 2:30 PM UTC
